newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement up to 4.803 million gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement up to 4.803 million gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended Sept 21 was 4,803,156 gallons compared with 4,716,630 gallons last week.
Imports were 93,493 gallons compared with zero gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled zero gallons versus 74,221 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 911,331 gallons compared with 1,223,225 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,313,443 gallons versus 4,163,356 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 221,095,557 versus 220,586,895 a year ago.
Inventory was 76,255,696 versus 86,373,490 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
